description: Change the selection: select items, Select All, Deselect All (Edit menu); Container, Content, Previous / Next Object in Group, First Object Above, Next Object Above, Next Object Below, Last Object Below (Object > Select and the object context menu); the whole group an item is in (Group Selection); a parent item on a document page, overriding it so it can be edited; or every ruler guide on a spread

action.description: What to select. container, content, group and the Object > Select commands start from target if given, else from the current selection

mode.description: For items: replace the selection, add to it, or remove from it

parentItemId.description: For parent_item: id of the item on the parent spread

spreadIndex.description: For all_guides: the spread (default: the active spread)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: select_layout_objects
title: Select Layout Objects
